title: AFP ends Territorial defense drill off eastern Mindanao seaboard

blocks.text: SAN FRANCISCO, Agusan del Sur — The Armed Forces of the Philippines (AFP) Eastern Mindanao Command (EastMinCom) wrapped up a four-day joint inter-agency defense exercise on Sunday across Surigao City, the Dinagat Islands, and key maritime corridors along the country’s eastern seaboard. Dubbed “Exercise Surigao Sentinel 01-2026,” the Oct. 22–25 maneuvers culminated with the 82nd anniversary of the historic World War II Battle of Surigao Strait. The drill aligned with the military’s Comprehensive Archipelagic Defense Concept (CADC) that tested readiness across land, sea, air, cyber, and information domains.
